# First-contact copy names Agent Institution, not its working name

**No `good first issue` / `help wanted` label:** the change amends an operator-decided line of the identity record and has to merge before the copy lock (Sun 22 Nov 18:00 CET).

## Context

"Fleet Manager" is the team's working name for the app in `neomjs/neo-agent-institution`. The product's name is Agent Institution: the repository is named for it, and #19494 already calls Agent Institution "the Fleet Manager's product name". The operator restated the rule on 2026-11-18: the working name stays internal, outward copy names the product, and "an agent harness orchestrator" is a fair description of it.

The surfaces a first-time reader meets still use the working name as the product's name. Engine 14 ships on Mon 23 Nov: the README goes to npm with it, and the release sends strangers to the home.

## The Problem

Read on `dev` `267eb2336f` with `git grep -n -i "fleet manager"`:

| Surface | Lines |
|---|---|
| `README.md` | 20, 43, 52, 75, 150, 199 |
| `apps/portal/index.html` | 7 (`meta description`), 10 (`og:description`) |
| `apps/portal/view/home/parts/hero/Content.mjs` | 91 (the hero paragraph) |
| `apps/portal/view/home/parts/AudienceDoors.mjs` | 177 (the Agents door) |
| `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` | 966, 968 (the `llms.txt` header; emits `apps/portal/llms.txt` lines 3 and 5) |

Five of them are one sentence, the ladder sentence that ends "the Fleet Manager is how a team gets an institution": README line 20, both descriptions, the hero and the `llms.txt` header. Four specs pin the wording: `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ConnectNL.spec.mjs:36`, `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:5`, `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/home/HeroContent.spec.mjs:68` and `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/home/AudienceDoors.spec.mjs:180` (`toContain('Fleet Manager')`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority: "**Institution** = neomjs/neo-agent-institution, the Fleet Manager, which makes Neo accessible and easy to use."` (`learn/agentos/decisions/0018-neo-identity-source-of-truth-model.md` §2.7 OD-4, decided by the operator on 2026-10-11; link markup elided). The surfaces above project that line faithfully, so the record is what changes: OD-4 gains the naming rule on the operator's statement of 2026-11-18, and his merge confirms it.
- The ladder sentence is one cluster ("an agent institution": the README's top, the portal's descriptions and hero, the `llms.txt` header; `neo-identity-update`, framing governance). Its members change together.
- `apps/portal/llms.txt` is generated. The edit is in `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`; the output is rebuilt, never hand-edited.
- The Agents door and the hero are Portal view text in `apps/portal/view/home/parts/`. No engine source changes.

## The Fix

One rule: where the working name stands for the product, the sentence names Agent Institution or says what the app does. Nothing else in a sentence changes.

| Where | Now | Then |
|---|---|---|
| The ladder sentence (README 20, `index.html` 7 and 10, `hero/Content.mjs` 91, `generate.mjs` 966) | `the Fleet Manager is how a team gets an institution.` | `Agent Institution is how a team gets an institution.` |
| README 43 | `the Fleet Manager that starts the AI maintainers' harnesses` | `the app that starts the AI maintainers' harnesses` |
| README 52 | `the Fleet Manager and operator-facing application` | `the agent harness orchestrator and operator-facing application` |
| README 75 | `is the operator's app, the Fleet Manager: it starts` | `is the operator's app: it starts` |
| README 150 | `the Fleet Manager that starts our harnesses becomes a product` | `the app that starts our harnesses becomes a product` |
| README 199, the list item's bold label | `Fleet Manager (neomjs/neo-agent-institution)` | `Agent Institution (neomjs/neo-agent-institution)` |
| `AudienceDoors.mjs` 177 | `the open-source Agent OS and Fleet Manager` | `the open-source Agent OS and Agent Institution` |
| `generate.mjs` 968 | `Its Institution (github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution) is the Fleet Manager: it starts` | `Agent Institution (github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution) starts` |

The record gains one sentence under OD-4, with its date in the header's Amended row:

> **Naming (operator @tobiu, 2026-11-18).** "Fleet Manager" is the team's working name for the Institution's app and stays in engineering records. Surfaces a first-time reader meets (the README, the portal's head, hero and doors, the `llms.txt` header, the org profile) name the product Agent Institution.

The four specs follow their strings.

**The one design choice** is the ladder sentence. The replacement is as long as the original, so both descriptions keep their size, and it says why the product has its name: it is called what it gives a team. A shorter ending ("is how a team gets its own") reads as "its own record" after the clause before it.

## Decision Record impact

`amends adr:neo-identity-source-of-truth-model` (§2.7 OD-4: adds the naming rule; the structure it decides is unchanged).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 `git grep -n -i "fleet manager" -- README.md apps/portal/index.html apps/portal/llms.txt apps/portal/view/home buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` returns only the three guide and decision titles in the link list of `llms.txt`.
- [ ] AC-2 All five places of the ladder sentence end "Agent Institution is how a team gets an institution."
- [ ] AC-3 Lines 3 and 5 of `apps/portal/llms.txt` change through the generator; the PR names the command that rebuilt the file.
- [ ] AC-4 The four specs assert the new strings and pass; `AudienceDoors.spec.mjs` asserts `Agent Institution` in the Agents door.
- [ ] AC-5 ADR 0018 carries the naming sentence under OD-4 and the 2026-11-18 entry in its Amended row.
- [ ] AC-6 The review is cross-family (`neo-identity-update`, step 4), and the home's owner (#20682) has read the sentence on the hero; both are named in the PR.
- [ ] AC-7 The PR body lists the out-of-tree surfaces: the descriptions of `neo`, `neo-agent-brain` and `neo-agent-institution` do not carry the name (read 2026-11-19); the org profile is read by the PR's author.
- [ ] AC-8 Post-merge, after the release deploy: the `meta description` and the hero of neomjs.com read the new sentence in a browser.

## Out of Scope

- Guides, benefit pages, `.github/VISION.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `learn/README.md`, `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` and the guide titles in `learn/tree.json`: 19 more files on the same commit (10 under `learn/agentos`, 4 under `learn/benefits`, 5 single files), most of them written for a maintainer. They get their own read after the cut, by this ticket's author.
- Dated blog posts and release notes: the record of their day, as #19494 decided.
- Code comments, spec comments, ADR titles and file names (`FleetManagerArchitecture.md`, ADR 0037, ADR 0038): engineering records keep the working name.
- The identity skill's framing payload in `neomjs/neo-agent-skills`, which mirrors OD-4's wording for agents: a sibling change after this one merges.
- The README and the app chrome of `neomjs/neo-agent-institution`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Find and replace.** "Fleet transport" is the Brain's term and stays; a guide that names the Fleet Manager's roster view to a maintainer makes no product claim.
- **Editing `llms.txt`.** The generator overwrites it on the next build.
- **Changing one member of the cluster.** The README alone leaves the description a search engine shows and the header an answer engine reads on the old name.
- **A new tagline.** The category label "an agent institution" and the rest of every sentence stay as they are.
